enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Sleep. Turn onto back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Occasionally move legs. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a simple breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying up the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Pull vacuum back. Move chair. Vacuum under chair. Move table. Vacuum under table. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put away vacuum. Pick up items from floor. Place items in designated spots. Dust surfaces with cloth. Arrange cushions on couch.

Leave house. Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Pay fare. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up shopping cart. Push cart through aisles. Select items. Place items in cart. Go to checkout. Pay. Bag groceries. Exit store. Walk to post office. Mail package. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and organizing the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Place grocery bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Take out items from bags. Place items in refrigerator. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Place dry goods in cabinet. Close cabinet. Break down bags. Throw away bags. Wipe counter with cloth.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, lettuce, tomato, cheese. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out plate and knife. Close cabinet. Place bread on plate. Spread mayonnaise. Add lettuce, tomato, cheese. Close sandwich. Cut sandwich in half. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Stand up. Clear plate. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out soda. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink soda. Watch TV. Put can on table. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a walk and exercising in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Leave house. Walk to park. Enter park. Walk along path. Jog along path. Stop. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Do push-ups. Do sit-ups. Sit on bench. Drink water. Watch people. Walk to another area. Do pull-ups on bar. Walk back home.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read emails. Type reply. Click send. Open web browser. Type website address. Press enter. Scroll through page. Click link. Read article. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Place book on table.
Enter bedroom. Turn on music player. Select song. Lie on bed. Listen to music. Tap foot. Hum. Change song. Listen. Close eyes. Continue listening. Turn off music player. Stand up.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out pan from cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear plate. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

Enter kitchen. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place glass in drying rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor with broom.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select movie. Watch movie. Pause movie. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Resume movie. Eat snack. Watch movie. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.
Enter bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down in bed.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn onto back. Sleep.
